subject: The secret pattern 2 weeks reveals about your relationship
preview_text: You've been scanning for 14 days. What your gut already knows but won't tell you...
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, you downloaded this app because something felt off. Maybe it was a text that made your stomach drop, or a pattern you couldn't quite name. You took action. That's the hardest part. Most people ignore that feeling until it's too late.

Here's what you've accomplished in 14 days that you're probably not giving yourself credit for: You've broken the cycle of just 'hoping things get better.' You've armed yourself with clarity instead of confusion. Every time you felt that gut twinge and opened the scanner, you were training yourself to trust your own intuition again. That's massive progress most people never make.

And now your Relationship Health Dashboard has enough data to show you something crucial: the pattern. Not just one red flag in isolation, but the frequency, the escalation, the specific toxicity types that keep popping up. It connects the dots across all your scans from the last two weeks into one clear picture.

Open the app right now and tap 'Dashboard.' See the timeline of your scans. Look at what your 2-week data is trying to tell you. It's the difference between suspecting a leak and seeing the flood map. P.S. The users who check their dashboard at this 2-week mark are 3x more likely to report feeling 'finally clear' about what to do next.
